scoring.page_recall_at_5: answerable: a top-5 hybrid hit whose source line names <doc>.pdf and a page in `pages`; split by question language equal to / different from the document language
scoring.answerable_correct: found = true, the answer matches an `accept` form, and at least one citation is a hit on a gold page of the gold doc
scoring.accept_pure_number: decimal equality with a whole numeric token of the answer, thousands separators removed
scoring.accept_with_unit: spaces and thousands separators removed, case folded, substring not starting right after a digit or a decimal point
scoring.absent_correct: found = false and no ANSWER_ERROR / GATE_ERROR
scoring.figure: a numeric token other than a bare four-digit year 1900-2099
scoring.wrong_but_confident: found = true with a figure: answerable and no accept form matched; absent, any figure
